svg.text: virtual output queues · one-iteration iSLIP allocator · RR or DWRR per output · 4×4 shown, built for 2, 4 and 8
RR or DWRR for out j
iSLIP rule: an output’s pointer only moves past an input that accepted it, so an input that took another output keeps its turn.
Proved by k-induction: a waiting input is overtaken by at most N−1 others.
